question: Which of the following is NOT a vertebrate class?
solution:
Correct answer is __**Annelida.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Annelids are recognized members of the **Lophotrochozoa**, a **"super-phylum" **of protostomes.
 
• It also involves** mollusks, brachiopods, and nemerteans**.
 
• The basic annelid form **consists of multiple segments.**
 
• The phylum includes **earthworms, polychaete worms, and leeches**.
 
• Annelids show** protostome development **in embryonic stages and are frequently known as **“segmented worms” **
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db98b6738c7cc00a9b6766adc34a94ca89c2f95075e31e1b177519f8c3d84bc7.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Cyclostomata are **the modified and degenerate offshoot of the primitive vertebrate stalk**.
 
• Pisces people are called for being **emotionally sensitive, gracious, and emotionally aware**.​ 
 
• Reptiles are **air-breathing vertebrates covered in special skin made up of scales, bony plates, or a combination of both**.
